title: Narrative Concepts
description: Core story-level concepts used by the narrative reasoning layer.

entries.title: Story Arc
entries.description: Overall story progression from setup to resolution.

entries.title: Story Goal
entries.description: The objective driving the story forward.

entries.title: Story Conflict
entries.description: The central pressure or opposition in the story.

entries.title: Story Resolution
entries.description: The ending phase that resolves or transforms the conflict.

entries.title: Story Progression
entries.description: The ordered movement of events across the narrative.

entries.title: Scene Goal
entries.description: The purpose of a scene at the local level.

entries.title: Scene Transition
entries.description: A shift between scenes, beats, or locations.

entries.title: Character Arc
entries.description: A character's evolution across the story.

entries.title: Relationship Arc
entries.description: The changing bond between characters over time.

entries.title: Motivation Change
entries.description: A shift in what a character wants or why they act.

entries.title: Belief Change
entries.description: A shift in what a character believes to be true.

entries.title: Moral Change
entries.description: A shift in a character's ethical stance.

entries.title: Tone Shift
entries.description: A noticeable change in emotional or stylistic tone.

entries.title: Theme
entries.description: The central idea or message of the story.

entries.title: Subtext
entries.description: Meaning implied beneath the literal wording.

entries.title: Hidden Meaning
entries.description: Meaning revealed by context rather than explicit wording.

entries.title: Symbolism
entries.description: Objects or actions that stand for deeper meaning.

entries.title: Foreshadowing
entries.description: An earlier clue that points toward a later event.

entries.title: Callback
entries.description: A later reference to an earlier detail.

entries.title: Plot Twist
entries.description: A surprising change that reinterprets previous events.

entries.title: Red Herring
entries.description: A misleading clue that pulls attention away from the real meaning.

entries.title: Flashback
entries.description: A return to an earlier event in time.

entries.title: Flashforward
entries.description: A preview of a later event or outcome.

entries.title: Dream
entries.description: A scene framed as a dream or dreamlike experience.

entries.title: Hallucination
entries.description: A scene framed as perception that may not be real.

entries.title: Imaginary Sequence
entries.description: A sequence that exists only in a character's mind.

entries.title: Voice Over
entries.description: Narration spoken over the visual scene.

entries.title: Unreliable Narrator
entries.description: A narrator whose account may not be trustworthy.

entries.title: Parallel Story
entries.description: A second story line that mirrors or contrasts the first.

entries.title: Background Story
entries.description: Events that happened before the current scene.

entries.title: Scene Description
entries.description: Visual or written description of what is happening.

entries.title: Environmental Storytelling
entries.description: Meaning conveyed through objects, space, or setting.

entries.title: Off Screen Event
entries.description: An event that happens outside the visible scene.

entries.title: Implicit Event
entries.description: An event inferred from context rather than directly shown.

entries.title: Missing Information
entries.description: A gap that prevents a full conclusion.

entries.title: Time Skip
entries.description: A jump forward or backward in time.
